goal: Add restart-safe file-backed Codex surrogate ingestion to the single formal Provider scheduler without changing candidate, acceptance, product-governance, benchmark, or delivery authority.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical request/response/receipt handshake validates run, project, job, attempt, stage, schema and hashes, rejects late/cross-run/path/kernel injections, and is idempotent for identical responses.
A minimal fresh text-count project completes planning, design, build, verification and local_packager delivery through the formal mainline with complete accounting.
Codex surrogate and deterministic replay install zero-network guards and record zero external Provider calls without silently falling back to live.
Explicit live, codex_surrogate, and deterministic_replay modes replace ambiguous Provider-type boolean combinations while live remains compatible.
Fresh planning, product/interaction/technical/acceptance design, initial build, repair, schema repair and design replan use the same Provider request/response adapter and accounting.
Frozen partial acceptance, candidate materialization/lineage, Product Design Depth Governance, benchmarks and public evidence gates remain unchanged.
WAITING_SURROGATE_RESPONSE pauses safely and restart-safe resume consumes an accepted response once without creating another scheduler or repeating completed stages.
